objective: The first group has one line of junk between the kept line and its spot — two deletes push it back one slot.
The second has two lines of junk — one more delete, so it's pushed back one slot further.

The third is different: yank the kept line instead of deleting it (it stays put), clear the junk after it, then paste that copy into the spot — a yank doesn't get pushed down by later deletes the way a delete does.
The fourth has three lines of junk — reach back one slot further still.
